name: @requestly/cross-q-context
description: The cross-q-context runtime — transform and (soon) execute every API-client script dialect (Postman pm.*/postman.*, Bruno bru.*) against the rq.* API. WebAssembly core, strings in / typed objects out. This build ships the compat (transform) pillar.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/cq-transform --target bundler --out-dir ../../packages/cross-q-context/engine --out-name cross_q_context && wasm-pack build ../../crates/cq-transform --target nodejs --out-dir ../../packages/cross-q-context/engine-node --out-name cross_q_context
